full_reset.minervini: Confirmed eligible FAIL arms the next confirmed transition into PASS
full_reset.breakout: Confirmed eligible FAILED (neither CANDIDATE nor READY) arms the next transition into SETUP_READY; CANDIDATE alone does not rearm
full_reset.confluence: Confirmed eligible Minervini FAIL or Breakout FAILED rearms; PASS plus CANDIDATE alone does not rearm

events.cooldown20: Confirmed inactive-to-active transition only; at least 20 exchange sessions since the last accepted event for this ticker and strategy; suppressed transitions are never emitted later while continuously active
events.unknown_data: Missing eligibility is UNKNOWN, not FAIL/reset; activation after an unknown previous state is left-censored and excluded until a confirmed reset/transition
events.warmup: Native pre-study states reconstructed with saved historical ranks; state and cooldown continue across IS/OOS boundaries
events.nonoverlap_sensitivity: Greedy chronological first-event retention per ticker/strategy/horizon, before quality filtering; next start must be at least horizon sessions after the previous retained start

quality.numeric_invalid: Missing/nonfinite/nonpositive OHLC, inconsistent OHLC bounds, negative/nonfinite volume, missing sessions, wrong instrument/currency; no undefined return imputation
quality.daily_jump_label: SUSPECT for gross close ratio >=2 or <=0.5; magnitude alone never proves INVALID
quality.split_unreconciled: SUSPECT when a declared material split and quote discontinuity resemble an unadjusted mechanical split; INVALID only if an independently different adjclose path confirms mixed quote units
quality.adjustment_rule: SUSPECT for large quote/adjclose adjustment-ratio discontinuity without a declared dividend/corporate action
quality.zero_volume_price_change: SUSPECT when zero reported volume accompanies a changed close
quality.identity_rule: Pre-declared-inception history or a provider market mismatch is SUSPECT; missing historical security/merger identity archive is a global limitation, not proof all otherwise clean rows are invalid
quality.quality_window: Maximum severity across the original 260-session feature window and every subsequent bar through the forward endpoint; computed after fixed event extraction
quality.all_panel: All arithmetically computable positive-price outcomes, including finite SUSPECT/INVALID basis observations; missing/undefined outcomes remain counted
quality.valid_panel: Only outcomes whose entire quality window is VALID; a retrospective data-quality sensitivity, never a live entry rule
quality.extreme_forward_rule: Gross horizon ratio >=10 or <=0.1 is audited; horizon magnitude alone does not change quality or delete the observation

random.primary: Same fixed event dates and selected counts; contemporaneous original eligible universe; apply identical retrospective quality masks only when evaluating outcomes; observed VALID counts may differ and are disclosed
random.spacing: FULL_RESET control minimum 2 sessions; COOLDOWN20 minimum 20 sessions per sampled ticker/strategy/replicate; no duplicate ticker within a date
random.valid_matched_secondary: Additional descriptive VALID-only control matches retained VALID event counts per date/horizon and the same quality-qualified retrospective universe; explicitly future-quality-conditioned and not a deployable strategy
random.statistic: Distribution of per-replicate mean forward returns; strategy median is also shown; half-tie empirical percentile for strategy mean
random.infeasible: Do not relax spacing, quality, universe or counts; disclose infeasible replicates

distribution.tail_analysis: Report top 1 percent contribution to the unmodified mean and share of gross positive returns; no removal or optimization
